text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon's passionate effort in
the race
leaves many of the spectators in
shock.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Well, that was something! Did you see
how
Bourbon ran?! She blew me away!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
She was definitely amazing, but do you
think
she'll be able to keep this up in
longer races?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I'm convinced! I can see her running with
that kind
of speed for 2,000 meters or
even more!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Make no mistake, Bourbon's got it in her
to be a
star player in next year's
Classics! She's got what
it takes to aim
for the Triple Crown!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: That was incredible, Bourbon...

If nothing else, the race ends up causing
many
people to acknowledge Mihono
Bourbon's dream.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I'm back, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. However, it is
unclear
whether or not I successfully
changed the public's
perception of me.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I did not hear words that clearly
expressed a shift
in opinion.

At the very least, the people around me
were
stunned by Mihono Bourbon's
running. I relay all
the details to her.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Status—"shock." I suppose there was a
marked
change in the crowd's
atmosphere.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I believe I have successfully
achieved
our objective today. Ready for
your next order,
Trainer.

Since we'll be tackling the Classics next
year, we
need to hit another milestone
first.

The Spring Stakes will serve as the
perfect test to
see whether Bourbon has
what it takes for the
Satsuki Sho.
choice_data_list: 『スプリングステークス』に出よう

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Order acknowledged. Browsing data...
The Spring
Stakes has a distance of
1,800 meters.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I surmise that I must enhance my stamina
even
further.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I wish to train after returning
home
today.

I respond to her enthusiasm with a
vigorous nod.

As I'm waiting for Mihono Bourbon by
the
racecourse entrance to return
home...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Bourbon was so great... Now, no one's
talking bad
about her.
A lone Umamusume emerges.

It's Rice Shower—a kind, reserved runner
in the
same year as Mihono Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I can't keep being afraid... I've made up
my mind!
I'm going to do my best too!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'll work super hard in the Twinkle
Series, and I'll
change...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'll become a new-and-improved Rice
Shower
who'll make everyone smile!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Rice Shower?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Gyah!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Did you just call my name? Is there
something you
require?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-B-Bourbon!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Ah, ah, um... uhhh... It's... just...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You were... really amazing in today's
race!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. That's very kind of
you to
say.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um, uh, that's, I...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: W-well, see you later!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...?
I wonder why she was so flustered.

In any case, the Asahi Hai Futurity
Stakes ends
without a hitch.

Now we set our sights on the next
race—the
Spring Stakes—and resume our
daily training!
